items.title: Workday Stock Soars to Best Day Since 2016 After Report of Potential Acquisition
items.summary: Workday  stock jumped on Thursday after a published report that private-equity firm Silver Lake is in talks to acquire the enterprise software company.  According to the Reuters report, which cited people familiar with the matter, Silver Lake and Workday have held discussions about a possible deal in recent months.  Barron’s has reached out to Workday and Silver Lake for comment.
